account:
It is day 0, about 11:02. I have been making my scheduled market walk. The residents I asked—Townsfolk 30, 20, 10, 08 and 18—said they had no news. I bought a fresh loaf for lunch at home at noon. I have not learned of any urgent town business or correspondence.

The unusual thing I have just heard is Townsfolk 08 and 18 repeating my exact greeting to the builder, including my request for an update on town works. Townsfolk 28 was also speaking, but I could not make out the words. I had seen the builder passing nearby carrying a lantern and called out to request an update; I have not heard a reply. The residents may simply be passing on what they heard, but I do not know why they repeated it word for word. The lantern could be for the builder's work, though I have no evidence of a particular project.

My three o'clock tea invitation is still unclear: the appointment book names only a neighbour at a dockside cottage on the east bank. I asked the secretary to verify the host and address. I have not heard a confirmed answer. My remaining engagements are noon lunch at home, accounts in the office at one, tea at three, the office at four thirty, and home at seven.
